# Dr. Gregory Jantz

> A comprehensive resource on whole-person mental health care, featuring a best-selling author, depression specialist, and founder of The Center • A Place of HOPE.

Dr. Gregory Jantz is a renowned mental health expert and prolific author who has pioneered whole-person care approaches to treating depression, anxiety, trauma, and addiction. The site serves as a hub for his books, media appearances, speaking engagements, and mental health content.

## Key Topics

- Whole-Person Care
- Depression Treatment
- Mental Health Expert
- Trauma Recovery
- The Center • A Place of HOPE
- Best-Selling Author
- Addiction Recovery
- Anxiety Treatment
- Eating Disorders Treatment
- DBT (Dialectical Behavior Therapy)
- Holistic Treatment Approach
- Keynote Speaker
- Media Appearances
- Healing Depression For Life
- Christian Perspective Mental Health
